mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM `order` GROUP BY status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m月%d日') as date, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as sales, COUNT(*) as orders FROM `order` WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m月%d日') ORDER BY MIN(create_time)

SELECT CONCAT('第', WEEK(create_time, 1) - WEEK(#{startDate}, 1) + 1, '周') as week, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as sales, COUNT(*) as orders FROM `order` WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} GROUP BY WEEK(create_time, 1), WEEK(#{startDate}, 1) ORDER BY MIN(create_time)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y年%m月') as month, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as sales, COUNT(*) as orders FROM `order` WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y年%m月') ORDER BY MIN(create_time)

SELECT oi.product_id as productId, COALESCE(p.product_name, CONCAT('商品#', oi.product_id)) as productName, SUM(oi.quantity) as quantity, SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity) as sales FROM order_item oi LEFT JOIN product p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY oi.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT #{limit}
